Name: ai auto translator
Author: XDynis
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#ff6b35]Stardew Valley MOD Auto Translation Tool[/color][/size]
[size=4]星露谷物语MOD全自动翻译工具[/size][/center]

[line]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Description / 工具介绍[/color][/size]

This tool automatically translates Stardew Valley MOD i18n files using AI technology, making it easy to localize mods into different languages. Supports all 12 official Stardew Valley languages with just 5 clicks to complete the entire translation process!

本工具使用AI技术自动翻译星露谷物语MOD的i18n文件，让MOD本地化变得简单快捷。全自动翻译工具，支持星露谷物语全12个国家语言，只需点击5次即可完成翻译！

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Features / 主要功能[/color][/size]

[list]
[*] Supports all 12 official Stardew Valley languages / 支持星露谷物语全部12种官方语言
[*] Ultra-fast workflow - complete translation in just 5 clicks / 超快工作流程 - 仅需5次点击完成翻译
[*] Local AI translation with Ollama + Qwen2.5 model - No API limits or restrictions / 基于本地部署模型Ollama + Qwen2.5模型的AI翻译，无需担心API限制和风控
[*] Automatic MOD package extraction and compression / 自动MOD包解压和打包
[*] Smart i18n file detection and extraction / 智能i18n文件检测和提取
[*] Batch translation with progress tracking / 批量翻译并显示进度
[*] Customizable translation speed settings / 可自定义翻译速度设置
[*] Modern GUI with multi-language support / 现代化界面，支持多语言
[*] Auto-save translation progress / 自动保存翻译进度
[/list]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Requirements / 系统要求[/color][/size]

[list]
[*] Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
[*] 4GB+ RAM (8GB+ recommended for better performance)
[*] Ollama service installed
[*] Qwen2.5 model downloaded
[/list]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Installation / 安装说明[/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#e74c3c]Step 1: Install Ollama / 安装Ollama[/color][/size]

1. Visit [url=https://ollama.ai/]Ollama Official Website[/url] / 访问Ollama官网
2. Download and install Ollama for Windows / 下载并安装Windows版本
3. Ollama will start automatically after installation / 安装后Ollama会自动启动

[size=4][color=#e74c3c]Step 2: Download Qwen2.5 Model / 下载Qwen2.5模型[/color][/size]

Open command prompt and run / 打开命令提示符并运行：

[code]
# Recommended model / 推荐模型
ollama pull qwen2.5:7b

# For lower-end PCs / 低配置电脑
ollama pull qwen2.5:3b

# For high-end PCs / 高配置电脑
ollama pull qwen2.5:14b
[/code]

[size=4][color=#e74c3c]Step 3: Verify Installation / 验证安装[/color][/size]

[code]
# Check Ollama status / 检查Ollama状态
ollama list

# Test model / 测试模型
ollama run qwen2.5:7b "Hello"
[/code]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]How to Use / 使用方法[/color][/size]

[size=4][color=#27ae60]Simple 6-Step Process / 简单6步流程[/color][/size]

[list=1]
[*] Launch the tool / 启动工具
[*] Import MOD package / 导入MOD压缩包
[*] Extract MOD files / 解压MOD文件
[*] Extract i18n files / 提取i18n文件
[*] Start auto translation / 开始自动翻译
[*] Package completed MOD / 打包完成的MOD
[/list]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Important Notes / 重要说明[/color][/size]

[list]
[*] Translation speed depends on your PC performance / 翻译速度取决于电脑性能
[*] You can adjust translation speed in settings / 可在设置中调整翻译速度
[*] Some texts might not be translated if not extracted to i18n / 某些文本可能因未提取到i18n而未翻译
[*] Make sure Ollama service is running on port 11434 / 确保Ollama服务在11434端口运行
[/list]

[size=5][color=#4a90e2]Troubleshooting / 故障排除[/color][/size]

[b]Translation stops halfway / 翻译中途停止：[/b]
Some texts weren't extracted to i18n files by the mod author / 作者某些文本没有提取到i18n文件

[b]Cannot connect to Ollama / 无法连接Ollama：[/b]
Check if Ollama service is running, usually requires port 11434 / 检查Ollama服务是否启动，通常需要端口11434

[b]Translation failed / 翻译失败：[/b]
File format might be corrupted / 可能文件格式有问题

[b]Slow translation / 翻译速度慢：[/b]
Try using a smaller model like qwen2.5:3b / 尝试使用更小的模型如qwen2.5:3b
